result.message: Stop guessing ports blind. You have two failed episodes already—check the event logs before committing a route this time. Read the events first, verify which port actually leads toward the goal, then route. Don't repeat the same reckless pattern that already cost you twice.
result.rationale: Learner has two consecutive failed outcomes at short horizon; micromanaging harsh-critical style demands a concrete process check (read before routing) rather than another blind commit.
